body.text: Two clocks run out today: the ATF comment record closes and the suppressor-export conference opens — while Virginia stays settled and New Jersey stays unanswered.

The lead is a deadline, not a development. Today is the last day of the ATF “engaged in the business” comment period — after close of business the record shuts and every “how to file a comment” asset becomes a retrospective. Simultaneously, NSSF's Import/Export Conference opens today (Aug 4–6).

facts.title: 1. ATF “engaged in the business” comment window closes today
2. Virginia AR-15 ban fight stays practically over
3. Viramontes/Grant — the clock other cases run to
